accepted.evidence: Turner4939 directly gives Shumashti ċō di go and neighboring Dardic čō go/imperative. Buddruss pairs Shumashti co with Grangali ca-, supplying a Grangali present and preterite to show it is a verbal stem; these forms belong to the local c- go family, without assigning the whole inflectional paradigm to a single ancestral tense. Reviewed source audit and import row matched; no transcription or identity changes.
